newsitem.title: FRANCE: France sets special Thomson-CSF share.
newsitem.headline: France sets special Thomson-CSF share.

text.p: In a decree published in the Official Journal, the Finance Ministry took a special measure to monitor possible changes in the shareholders structure of privatisation candidate Thomson-CSF.
"To protect national interests, a common share held by the state in the capital of Thomson CSF is turned into a special share," the decree said.

"Any move to control more than a tenth or a multiple of a tenth of the capital or the voting rights of the company by a physical or a moral person, operating alone or in concerted action, must first be approved by the minister in charge of the economy," the decree said.
